preconditions.name: ao_head_reinit_divergence
preconditions.description: The re-draws of action_object_head must genuinely differ. Below this floor the manipulation was never applied and any null is about nothing.
preconditions.control: worst seed's mean pairwise L2 between the 4 re-drawn parameter vectors, measured directly on the head

preconditions.name: cem_elite_refit_consumed_action_objects
preconditions.description: The CEM elite refit (module.py:1400-1409) is the only path by which the head reaches behaviour. This is the fraction of matched-state propose_trajectories calls returning candidates that carry action-object sequences. Below the floor the head was never read.
preconditions.control: worst seed in the D1 matched-state bank, where the CEM path is exercised by construction

preconditions.name: d2_cross_seed_spread_nondegenerate
preconditions.description: SAME STATISTIC the load-bearing C2 routes on: C2 is a ratio of the across-init spread of survival_ratio to its across-seed spread. If that DENOMINATOR is ~0 the ratio is meaningless and an apparent invariance would be an artefact of a pinned DV, not a finding.
preconditions.control: ordinary seed-to-seed variation of the terrain advantage, measured within each ao_init and averaged

preconditions.name: residue_field_shaped_by_warmup_harm
preconditions.description: EXQ-003's own C3. TERRAIN is terrain-guided CEM over the residue field; with zero warmup harm the terrain is unshaped and the contrast is not EXQ-003's.
preconditions.control: worst cell across all seeds x inits
